verdict.rationale: Greenhouse ships several AI-generated insights/suggestions features (AI note-taker mapping notes to scorecard questions, Talent Matching tiering applications by risk/relevance, AI-powered report filters, ML-based offer forecast), which fits the theme of AI-generated insights inside the product. However, this is vendor-embedded AI functionality rather than an open agentic/insight layer a user can query freely, and there's no evidence of conversational or exploratory AI insight generation across arbitrary data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of these AI features, evidence of an open-ended AI assistant that answers ad-hoc questions over recruiting data, and detail on accuracy/quality of the AI-generated insights.
